name: ui2api
description: Turn any site you use into AI tools — analyze a site's real action recipes once, then generate a per-site MCP or ACP server so your AI agent can drive it by calling tools.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const{writeFileSync,mkdirSync}=require('node:fs');const g=(a)=>{try{return execFileSync('git',a,{encoding:'utf8',timeout:5000,stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).trim()}catch{return null}};const c=g(['rev-parse','HEAD']);let d=null;if(c){const s=g(['status','--porcelain']);d=s===null?null:s.length>0}const p='dist/runtime/build-info.json';mkdirSync('dist/runtime',{recursive:true});writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify({commit:c,builtAt:new Date().toISOString(),dirty:d},null,2)+'\n')"
